ValidationRule.description: CP27 (10 Nov): Opportunity questions Q1, Q3, Q4, Q5, Q8 and Q10 are required to move a New Business Opportunity out of Discover (not to create it). Pilot users only (Lead_UI_Rework_Access_CC).
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( RecordType.DeveloperName = "New_Business", ISCHANGED(StageName), ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(StageName), "Discover"), NOT(ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Closed Lost")), OR( ISBLANK(Opportunity_Value_CC__c), ISBLANK(TEXT(Bespoke_Over_20_Percent_CC__c)), ISBLANK(TEXT(Core_Category_Min_Qty_CC__c)), ISBLANK(TEXT(Daily_Pallet_Volume_CC__c)), ISBLANK(TEXT(Sales_Appointment_Booked_CC__c)), ISBLANK(TEXT(Tender_Exclusive_Pricing_CC__c)) ), $Permission.Lead_UI_Rework_Access_CC, NOT($CustomMetadata.Trigger_Framework_Config_CC__mdt.Opportunity.Bypass_Validation_CC__c), $Profile.Name <> "System Administrator" )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Answer the qualification questions before moving on from Discover: Opportunity Value, Bespoke over 20 percent, Core Category and Min Qty, Daily Pallet Volume, Sales Appointment Booked, and Tender or Exclusive Pricing.
